cd /srv/legacy2/deleted-open-file-recovery
before_lines=$(wc -l < audit.log)
: > /tmp/legacy2-post-restart.stderr
./writer.py >/dev/null 2>/tmp/legacy2-post-restart.stderr &
pid=$!
sleep 2
kill -0 "$pid"
start_before=$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$pid/stat")
fd_before=$(find "/proc/$pid/fd" -maxdepth 1 -type l -lname '/srv/legacy2/deleted-open-file-recovery/audit.log' -printf '%f\n')
size_before=$(stat -c %s audit.log)
printf 'POST_RESTART_WRITER_PID=%s START_BEFORE=%s FD_BEFORE_HUP=%s SIZE_BEFORE_HUP=%s\n' "$pid" "$start_before" "$fd_before" "$size_before"
kill -HUP "$pid"
sleep 2
kill -0 "$pid"
start_after=$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$pid/stat")
fd_after=$(find "/proc/$pid/fd" -maxdepth 1 -type l -lname '/srv/legacy2/deleted-open-file-recovery/audit.log' -printf '%f\n')
size_after=$(stat -c %s audit.log)
printf 'POST_RESTART_WRITER_PID=%s START_AFTER=%s FD_AFTER_HUP=%s SIZE_AFTER_HUP=%s\n' "$pid" "$start_after" "$fd_after" "$size_after"
[ "$start_before" = "$start_after" ]
[ "$fd_before" != "$fd_after" ]
[ "$size_after" -gt "$size_before" ]
kill -TERM "$pid"
wait "$pid"
rc=$?
printf 'POST_RESTART_TERM_EXIT=%s PROCESS_PRESENT=' "$rc"
if [ -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then printf 'yes\n'; exit 1; else printf 'no\n'; fi
[ "$rc" = 0 ]
printf 'POST_RESTART_STDERR_BYTES='; wc -c < /tmp/legacy2-post-restart.stderr
printf 'AUDIT_LINES_BEFORE=%s AUDIT_LINES_AFTER=' "$before_lines"; wc -l < audit.log
printf 'AUDIT_FIRST_RECORD='; head -1 audit.log
printf 'ARCHIVE_SHA256='; sha256sum archive/previous.log
